title: Every recovered craft gets a reverse-engineered copy

tellings.quote: From my understanding, from what's been relayed to me was that every craft that they recover, they also make reverse engineered versions of trying to replicate that technology or that specific craft.

plain: Every craft the government recovers is said to get a copy built by reverse engineering, meaning engineers take the original apart to learn how it works and then try to replicate "that technology or that specific craft." Michael Herrera, a guest who says he saw a 300-foot craft in the Indonesian jungle, tells Michels this as something that was "relayed to me" by people he does not name. If true, it would mean there are human-made versions of these craft.
